validate.description: Validate one corpus, without --fix. `input.corpus` is a corpus folder relative to this file's folder. `expect` holds the `<file>: <field>` prefix of each error and of each warning, with the file relative to the corpus root: the text of a problem line up to its second `: `. Each list is sorted by UTF-16 code unit and holds each prefix once. An implementation passes a case when its two sets of prefixes match these. Message text and order are not compared.

cases.name: a broken corpus reports each problem
